description: This file defines jQuery color animation functions, including color parsing, color space conversions, CSS hooks for color properties, and a color name map. It implements color manipulation and animation features for jQuery.

classes.name: jQuery.Color
classes.description: A class for color objects supporting parsing, conversion, blending, and string output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses color input (string, array, object) into a color object.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the color is the same as another color.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Interpolates between this color and another color.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Blends this color with another, considering alpha transparency.

methods.name: toRgbaString
methods.description: Returns the color as an 'rgba()' string.

methods.name: toHslaString
methods.description: Returns the color as an 'hsla()' string.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Returns the color as a hexadecimal string, optionally including alpha.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the color as a string, defaulting to 'transparent' if alpha is 0.
